questions.question_text: Complete the verse from Bhaktichintamani 68/9: "Mārā janne antakāḷe, jarūr māre āvvu; Birud māru e na badle, te sarve janne _______."
questions.explanation: The Bhaktichintamani 68/9 verse states: "Mārā janne antakāḷe, jarūr māre āvvu; Birud māru e na badle, te sarve janne jaṇāvvu."

questions.question_text: According to Bhaktichintamani 68/9, what is guaranteed to happen at 'antakāḷe' for 'mārā janne'?
questions.explanation: The text from Bhaktichintamani 68/9 explicitly states: "Mārā janne antakāḷe, jarūr māre āvvu".

questions.question_text: As per Brahmanand Swami's Kirtan (Stanza 1), who are 'harijan sāchā'?
questions.explanation: Stanza 1 of Brahmanand Swami's Kirtan says: "Harijan sāchā re, je urmā himmat rākhe...".

questions.question_text: According to Brahmanand Swami's Kirtan (Stanza 1), what do true Harijans not do when 'vipatti varatī'?
questions.explanation: Stanza 1 states: "Vipatti varatī re, kedī dīn vachan nav bhākhe...".

questions.question_text: How do true Harijans view 'jagnu sukhduḥkh' according to Brahmanand Swami's Kirtan (Stanza 2)?
questions.explanation: Stanza 2 states: "Jagnu sukhduḥkh re, māyik mithyā karī jāṇe...".

questions.question_text: When 'tan dhan jātā', what do true Harijans not bring to their 'antarmā' as per Brahmanand Swami's Kirtan (Stanza 2)?
questions.explanation: Stanza 2 states: "Tan dhan jātā re, antarmā shok na āṇe...".

questions.question_text: In Brahmanand Swami's Kirtan (Stanza 3), how are 'par upkārī jan' described regarding their 'premniyam'?
questions.explanation: Stanza 3 states: "Par upkārī re, jan premniyammā pūrā...".

questions.question_text: What is said about 'sādhu shūrā' in 'daihik duḥkhmā' in Brahmanand Swami's Kirtan (Stanza 3)?
questions.explanation: Stanza 3 states: "Daihik duḥkhmā re, dāzhe nahi sādhu shūrā...".

questions.question_text: How do true Harijans remember Hari, as described in Brahmanand Swami's Kirtan (Stanza 4)?
questions.explanation: Stanza 4 states: "Harine samare re, nitya ahonish umang bhariyā...".

questions.question_text: According to Brahmanand Swami's Kirtan (Stanza 5), what do true Harijans not do even if 'Mastak jātā'?
questions.explanation: Stanza 5 states: "Mastak jātā re, nav mele ṭek vichārī...".
